environment.execution: One benchmark process at a time; affinity/power/background load uncontrolled; filesystem/import caches may be OS-warm; no cross-host comparison.

workloads.filter_256: Stable prefix filtering over 256 caller-supplied synthetic suggestions.
workloads.form_error: Three fields; explicit validation and first-error reveal.
workloads.long_review_page: Synthetic target of 512 CJK characters; full details wrapping and paging stress.

conditions.window: One UI-owned keyboard event through models/layout/paint into a fresh cell buffer; GC enabled.
conditions.units: microseconds; separate untimed traced Python bytes/blocks
conditions.limits: No scheduler pacing, renderer/output acknowledgement, OS terminal, human input, clipboard, domain/application, RSS or absolute performance gate. No change to #304 budgets.
conditions.memory: Untimed window includes fixture construction, canonical state, wrapping and frame; not cumulative allocations.
